CA.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation relation to the identified content is present.

COD.rationale: Content (red positions), an organization/access descriptor (origin), and a separate status/organization distinction are all explicitly present and bound to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or processing-condition claim is tied to a specific content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple lines explicitly identify contents (grid cell sets) with named attributes (red, blue) and referents.

D.rationale: The report separately records identified content (positions) and a status/organization descriptor (origin) for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: Origin and inherited_current fields describe how the content is represented/accessed (organization/presentation) within the record/candidate structure.
